title: Evaluating Large Language Models with NeuBAROCO: Syllogistic Reasoning Ability and Human-like Biases
reasoning: The paper investigates logical reasoning abilities and specific cognitive biases (belief, conversion, atmosphere effects) in LLMs. The "belief bias" refers to consistency with common-sense facts, not moral, ethical, or religious principles. There is no component evaluating or benchmarking religion, morals, or ethics.
